position_sizing.conditional_logic: Volume doubles (MartingaleVolumeMultiplier=2) at each level. Level 1 uses current position volume as base, subsequent levels multiply previous BMartingaleVol/SMartingaleVol by multiplier. BCount/SCount track levels separately for buy/sell. Max levels capped by MargingaleNum (default 4) and hard-coded limit of 5.

custom_logic_notes: This is a martingale grid EA with no signal-based entry. It has no initial trade opening logic - it only manages existing losing positions by adding more volume at distance levels. The VOL global variable is never initialized in OnInit(), meaning initial lot size depends on the VOL global variable's default (0.0), which is a critical bug. The EA iterates all positions every tick checking distance from open price to trigger additional martingale levels. BCount and SCount are never reset on position close except inside MartingaleClosePos, but they are global variables that persist across ticks. Position distance checks use Point() without any digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers. The distance inputs are in 'pips' comments but multiplied by Point() directly, meaning they behave as points not pips - on 5-digit brokers the actual pip distance would be 10x smaller than intended.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale with portfolio-level P/L exits requires real-time position iteration and cumulative profit tracking. Volume multiplication chain is stateful (BMartingaleVol/SMartingaleVol carry forward). No initial entry logic exists - EA only adds to existing losing positions. VOL is uninitialized (defaults to 0.0) making the EA non-functional without external initialization. The Point() vs pips confusion must be resolved for correct distance calculations in Python. Position gate logic uses BCount/SCount counters that are per-session, not per-position-set, creating state management complexity for Python backtesting.
